turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you check our equipment purchase rules document? I need to know what corporate requires from the branch before buying a piece of equipment over the $600 threshold, and what records we have to keep afterwards.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text:
**Before purchase** (over $600 ex tax): you need a dated supplier quote, a signed CE-2 form sent to Corporate Administration, and written approval back on the form before you place the order. Order before approval = no reimbursement, sits on the branch card.

**After purchase:** supplier's itemised invoice (with serial number if the item carries one) goes to Corporate Admin within 30 days. Asset tag applied at the branch, number written on your copy. Asset register line opened the day the item arrives. Quote, approved CE-2, invoice copy and register line kept for seven years from year end.

One thing that trips people up: an invoice with no serial number on an item that carries one gets kicked back — most suppliers will reissue once if you ask.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Got it, that covers what I needed on the quote, CE-2, and seven-year retention.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Glad that covers it. The CE-2 form is the only gate — everything else is paperwork you already keep.
